summary: Strengthen property underwriting, financing and portfolio decisions with practical Excel casework. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Real estate investment and finance training helps property analysts, asset managers and finance professionals assess deals and support capital decisions. Participants build Excel underwriting models, analyze NOI, NPV and IRR, test borrowing capacity with DSCR, debt yield and LTV scenarios, and review refinancing sensitivity. They also develop portfolio measures and investment committee recommendations using IVS-informed valuation assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess property cash flows, arrange financing or advise on real estate capital allocation. It suits intermediate learners with some exposure to property income, investment analysis or financial spreadsheets.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with property income, operating costs and basic financial spreadsheets is recommended. No coding or programming is required; you will use Excel for case-based calculations and scenario analysis.
